transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with severe mood swings for over a year now. I keep alternating between periods where I feel extremely high energy and highly irritable, and other times when I crash into a deep depression and feel completely exhausted. It has gotten to the point where it's really hard to manage on my own.
During those high-energy periods, have you ever experienced any beliefs that others found strange, or heard or seen things that weren't actually there?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. Even during my highest-energy periods, I've never seen or heard things that weren't there, nor have I had any strange beliefs.
During those high-energy periods, have you ever had to be hospitalized, or did your behavior become so severe that it caused significant problems with your job or relationships?

No, I have never been hospitalized during those high periods. However, my behavior has definitely caused some serious strain on my relationships and finances because I tend to go on reckless, unrestrained buying sprees that I can't really afford.
During those high-energy periods when you go on these buying sprees, do these episodes last for at least four days, and is the change in your functioning noticeable to those around you?

Yes, those high-energy phases and shopping sprees definitely last much longer than four days, and this whole pattern has been going on for over a year now. The change in my behavior is extremely noticeable to everyone around me, especially because my reckless spending has caused serious financial distress for my family.

Even though your symptoms last longer than four days, did your high-energy episodes ever reach a point where you were completely unable to function at work or in daily life, or did they only cause noticeable changes that others could observe?

They only caused noticeable changes that others could observe, rather than making me completely unable to function. I was still able to manage my daily tasks and go to work, even though my behavior was very erratic.
